title: An Auditable AI Agent Loop for Empirical Economics: A Case Study in Forecast Combination
summary: An Auditable AI Agent Loop for Empirical Economics: A Case Study in Forecast Combination Philadelphia Federal Reserve Bank
body: An Auditable AI Agent Loop for Empirical Economics: A Case Study in Forecast Combination Philadelphia Federal Reserve Bank
summaryZh: 费城联邦储备银行发布案例研究，探讨了如何构建可审计的AI智能体循环（Agent Loop），并将其应用于经验经济学中的预测组合任务，为金融和经济领域的智能体落地提供了合规和透明的实践路径。原始信息显示：An Auditable AI Agent Loop for Empirical Economics: A Case Study in Forecast Combination Philadelphia Federal Reserve Bank。该消息由Philadelphia Federal Reserve Bank发布，主题为“An Auditable AI Agent Loop for Empirical Economics: A Case Study in Forecast Combination”。其重要性主要体现在：费城联储探讨了可审计AI智能体循环在经验经济学和预测组合中的应用。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
